claims.assumptions: finite binary space; Boolean quadratic with alternating polar rank r
claims.quantifiers: all dimensions and quadratics, including zero rank
claims.statement: For every n and degree-at-most-two q:F2^n->F2 with alternating polar Bq of rank r, r is even, Wq support is affine l0+im(Bq), each supported normalized value has magnitude 2^(-r/2), its sign is quadratic in support coordinates, and binary elimination constructs the support, origin and sign.
claims.unresolved_bridge: formal algorithm and bit cost, not just an abstract support theorem

claims.assumptions: literal two-phase source, symmetric invertible J, basis input, measured output, derived Q/support/coordinates
claims.quantifiers: all admitted sources, affine origins, inputs, offsets and r=0
claims.statement: For every admitted n,J,f0,f1,beta,e and constructed r,S,D,C,R,d0,eta,s, O=FJ Df1 FJ Ze FJ Df1 FJ=FJ DQ FJ Ze is real Hermitian unitary Clifford, maps sector a to a+eta with the stated flat quadratic kernel, and X_a is real, bounded by 1, shift-symmetric, and averages to 1-2p; norm(psi_(a+eta)+O_a psi_a)^2=2+2X_a.
claims.unresolved_bridge: connect formal circuit and all normalizations to literal gate replay

claims.assumptions: verified restricted tensor certificate T(K,K,K)=0, codimension k
claims.quantifiers: all sectors and verified control frames
claims.statement: For every sector a and verified k-dimensional restricted control space U with T(ker U,ker U,ker U)=0, construction yields exactly 2^k normalized stabilizer slices with coefficients 2^(-k/2), and conditioning both sides expresses the coherent overlap as 4^k real quadratic sums.
claims.unresolved_bridge: construct actual branches and coefficients, not a supplied decomposition

claims.assumptions: k<=q control certificate and a rank-2k contraction anchor, or separately stated deterministic shortcuts
claims.quantifiers: every promised input and bounded random tape
claims.statement: verified discovery; failure <=2^(-h-1); probe/candidate caps and sound refusals
claims.unresolved_bridge: algorithm semantics, shortcut completeness boundaries and explicit bit-cost model

claims.assumptions: finite complex vector; independent uniform Z4 diagonal phases and fair graph bits
claims.quantifiers: all even or odd widths and all vectors, including zero
claims.statement: For every r>=0 and u:F2^r->C, independent d_j uniform in Z4 and graph bits uniform in F2 give Z=2^r|<phi_A,u>|^2, E[Z]=||u||^2, E[Z^2]=2||u||^4-sum_t|u(t)|^4, and Var(Z)<=||u||^4.
claims.unresolved_bridge: connect explicit ensemble and exact Gaussian arithmetic to source-constructed u

claims.assumptions: sound discovered frame and uniform orbit/equatorial sampling; b,h>=1
claims.quantifiers: all accepted frames and all admitted source inputs
claims.statement: For b,h>=1 and every sound accepted control frame, independent uniform orbit and equatorial draws give E[Y]=1-2p and Var(Y)<=4. L=32*4^b draws in each of K=2h+3 independent groups, median, final projection and b+2 bit downward rounding give error <=3*2^(-b)/4 except with probability <2^(-h-1); the promised discovery/readout union failure is <2^(-h).
claims.unresolved_bridge: independence, finite tape sampling and final-only clipping

claims.assumptions: specified dense algorithms, cap q, literal source length B, b,h>=1
claims.quantifiers: all tapes, including refusals; success conditional on stated promises
claims.statement: For literal source bit length B, m=n+r, cap q, A_q=4^q(h+2), C_q=4(q+1)2^(q^2), K=2h+3 and N=32*4^b*K: time is O~((B+m+q+2)^12+(r+A_q)(1+C_q)(m+q+2)^10+N*2^(k+2)*(m+q+2)^10+(N+K+1)*(m+b+h+q+2)^4); space is O~((B+m+q+2)^8+(m+b+h+q+2)^4); fair bits are <=r*A_q+N*(c-1_(eta != 0)+2r+r(r-1)/2). Exact quadratic shortcut uses one real Gaussian sum, zero random bits and polynomial precision cost.
claims.unresolved_bridge: define and verify executable cost accounting for all listed phases

claims.assumptions: even t>=2 and explicitly specified source family
claims.quantifiers: all such t and separately qualified variations
claims.statement: For every even t>=2, n=t^2+2t+2, identity J, zero input and measured c0, the specified f0,f1 yield r=t^2+2 and a deterministic restricted k=1 certificate. Every global first-cubic certificate has g>=t-sqrt(t); the output probability is 1/4-2^(-t-1)+2^(-2t-1), complemented by the specified output-linear term.
